title: Lower inherited object-model ivar layout into IR without recomputing offsets

mode_matrix.name: native-ir
abi_requirements: Objc3IRRuntimeMetadataPropertyBundle and Objc3IRRuntimeMetadataIvarBundle carry sema-owned offset, padding, inherited-slot, inherited-size, owner-size, init-order, destroy-order, validity, and replay-key fields
emit_ivar_descriptor_section writes @__objc3_meta_ivar_offset_* globals from executable_ivar_layout_offset_bytes instead of recomputing owner-local offsets
OC3LayoutChild.token lowers to offset 8 and OC3LayoutChild.childFlag lowers to offset 16 because OC3LayoutBase contributes two inherited slots and owner size 8
per-owner layout tables are ordered by executable_ivar_layout_slot_index and publish OC3LayoutChild owner size 24
property and ivar descriptor records both carry the layout replay key so runtime reflection does not infer layout from source declarations
runtime_requirements: AttachRealizedPropertyLayoutRecordsUnlocked validates descriptor/layout-record/offset-global consistency before marking runtime_layout_ready
runtime instance size uses the sema-published owner_size_bytes when it is larger than a local max-end alignment calculation
objc3_runtime_property_entry_snapshot exposes padding, inherited layout counts, owner size, order indexes, layout validity, and replay key for testing

abi_field_stability.stability_property: IR offset globals are a direct serialization of sema-approved executable_ivar_layout_offset_bytes
runtime-facing descriptors preserve the exact sema replay key for layout provenance and replay checks
